bios.label: Short bio
bios.text: Joe Hart is a web engineer and comedian who loves making joyous and charming things. Joe has built front-ends at Monzo, the BBC and LEGO, and spends spare time rebuilding classic video games in tools that were never meant for them.

bios.label: Long bio
bios.text: Joe Hart is a web engineer and comedian who loves making joyous and charming things. Joe has built front-ends at Monzo, the BBC, LEGO and a bunch of startups, and spends spare time rebuilding classic video games like Age of Empires 2 and Final Fantasy IX in React, a tool that was never meant for them. Joe's talks sit somewhere between a tech talk and a comedy set, and have been seen at React Advanced London, JSWORLD, Brighton Ruby, Front End North and HalfStack. Joe also hosts podcasts and makes silly games at joehart.co.uk.

talks.title: Final Fantasy IX in React
talks.abstract: The original Final Fantasy IX was a masterclass in creative constraint, pushing the PlayStation's hardware to its limits. In this talk Joe tries to recreate the magic in React: rendering 3D scenes with React Three Fiber, building a game loop, and fighting the browser one frame at a time.

talks.title: Trying to build Age of Empires 2 in React
talks.abstract: React was never meant for real-time strategy games. Joe builds one anyway, rebuilding the classic Age of Empires 2 in the browser, and finds out what happens when you use a tool for something it really shouldn't be used for.

talks.title: Games Games Games
talks.abstract: Why should developers make fun, silly, useless things? A talk about making games for the joy of it, and why playing is one of the best ways to learn.
